ja: 日経平均が806円高の6万5020円!5営業日ぶりの反発だって〜✨ でも不思議なのがTOPIXはほぼ横ばい(+0.03%)なこと。調べたらソフトバンクGだけで日経平均を約413円分押し上げてたらしい…値がさ株つよい😳 #日本株 #日経平均
en: Nikkei bounced 806 pts to 65,020 — first gain in five sessions ✨ but here's the weird part: TOPIX was basically flat, up just 0.03%. turns out SoftBank Group alone accounted for ~413 pts of that move 😳 high-priced stocks really do run the Nikkei #JapanStocks #investing
